text:
2. [LDET.5.5] **Activation-creation order — the second key, within one
   rule.** Among activations *of the same rule*, partial matches that
   completed earlier fire before those completed later, by a monotonic
   creation timetag assigned when the match completes. A match completes
   when the last of its facts enters working memory; a fact that is
   replaced ([LFAC.1.2.2]) enters anew.

   **Matches that complete together are ordered by their facts.** One
   assertion can complete several matches of one rule at once — the new
   fact joining several partners. Among those, the engine **must** assign
   timetags in the lexicographic order of the matches' facts, compared
   pattern by pattern from the first pattern, each fact ranked by when it
   entered working memory. The timetag is therefore a function of the
   match and of working memory alone. The order in which the engine's
   memories happen to be traversed **must not** affect it ([LDET.5.9]).

   **It never decides between two different rules.** Those are separated
   by `[LDET.5.4]` before this key is reached — which is what keeps the
   order out of the hands of propagation internals.

alloy.name: ldet_5_5__one_activation_per_rule_per_timetag
alloy.note: DERIVED: two distinct matches of one rule are strictly ordered by the timetag, from facts about construction alone (assertion positions form a sequence, a match atom names a tuple, the agenda is a set of matches). The key it derives from is the clause's: the tuple of the matched facts' assertion positions, compared by latest position, which is when the match completed, then lexicographically in pattern order. TEETH: with the positions fact disabled this check fails.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__first_pending_ok
idris.note: What it returns is eligible.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__first_pending
idris.note: Within one rule, the earliest-created eligible activation: tokens are appended in creation order and never reordered.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__before
idris.note: THE CREATION TIMETAG as an order: earlier completion first, then pattern order among matches one event completes. A reading: the clause leaves the tiebreak unnamed.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__before_keys
idris.note: The order on keys: the earlier completion first, then pattern order.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__insert
idris.note: A new activation takes its timetag's place among the rule's.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__key
idris.note: The key: the positions of the tuple's facts, in pattern order.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__latest
idris.note: When a match completed: the latest position of its key.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__lex_lt
idris.note: Lexicographic order on position lists.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__lt
idris.note: The strict order on positions, by structural recursion so a proof can unfold it.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__max
idris.note: The larger of two positions, structurally.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__pos
idris.note: The assertion position of a live fact: its index in the working-memory sequence, its id's rank under [IRET.4.4].

idris.name: ltac_5_4__same_tick_ready
idris.note: Two matches that complete together, ordered by their facts' positions: the earlier-asserted timer first. Computed.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__canonical_agrees
idris.note: The canonical key sorts each history's matches over the working memory both share to the same list.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__canonical_order
idris.note: The key's order on the instance: (a1, b2) then (a1, b3) -- both completed by a1, the earlier B first.

idris.name: ldet_5_9__network_agrees
idris.note: The model's terminals carry the key's order on both histories.

idris.name: Ldet_5_5__live
idris.note: A live match: every fact of the token is in working memory.

idris.name: Ldet_5_5__live_acts
idris.note: Every activation of a terminal is of live facts.

idris.name: Ldet_5_5__sorted
idris.note: A terminal in agenda order under a working memory: each activation before every later one.

idris.name: iret_8_1__activate_sorted
idris.note: ACTIVATING distinct live new matches keeps the terminal sorted and live: each takes its timetag's place.

idris.name: iret_8_1__end_sorted
idris.note: Ending activations keeps the terminal sorted: a sublist of a sorted list.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__before_append
idris.note: The order between two live matches is unchanged by an assertion.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__before_asym
idris.note: The timetag order on matches is asymmetric.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__before_irrefl
idris.note: The timetag order on matches is irreflexive.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__before_keys_asym
idris.note: The key order is asymmetric.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__before_keys_irrefl
idris.note: The key order is irreflexive.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__before_keys_total
idris.note: The key order orders any two distinct keys: earlier completion first, then pattern order.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__before_keys_trans
idris.note: The key order is transitive.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__before_nil
idris.note: The nil token's key precedes every non-empty key: a rule of only NOT patterns is active first.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__before_total
idris.note: THE TIMETAG IS A STRICT TOTAL ORDER ON LIVE MATCHES: two distinct live matches are ordered one way or the other. What [IRET.1.9]'s 'decides among activations of one rule' needs of the second key.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__before_trans
idris.note: The timetag order on matches is transitive.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__elem_tail
idris.note: A member of a list that is not its head field-wise is a member of its tail.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__eq_comm
idris.note: Position equality is symmetric.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__insert_all
idris.note: A property of every activation and of the inserted one holds of every activation after the insert.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__insert_sorted
idris.note: Inserting a live activation at its timetag's place keeps a sorted terminal of live activations sorted.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__key_append
idris.note: A live match's key is unchanged by an assertion: the timetag is fixed when the match completes.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__key_inj
idris.note: Two live matches with one key are one match: over distinct working memory the key determines the match.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__latest_elem
idris.note: A match's completion position is one of its facts' positions.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__lex_asym
idris.note: The pattern-order tiebreak is asymmetric.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__lex_irrefl
idris.note: The pattern-order tiebreak is irreflexive.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__lex_total
idris.note: The pattern-order tiebreak orders any two distinct keys.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__lex_trans
idris.note: The pattern-order tiebreak is transitive.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__lt_asym
idris.note: The position order is asymmetric.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__lt_irrefl
idris.note: The position order is irreflexive.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__lt_neq
idris.note: Ordered positions are unequal.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__lt_trans
idris.note: The position order is transitive.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__lt_tri
idris.note: Two positions not ordered one way and unequal are ordered the other: trichotomy.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__map_all
idris.note: Two maps agreeing pointwise on a list agree on it.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__map_map
idris.note: A map of a map is the map of the composite.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__max_ge
idris.note: The larger of two positions not ordered the one way is the first.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__max_lt
idris.note: The larger of two ordered positions is the later.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__max_z
idris.note: Zero is the identity of the larger-of.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__nil_before
idris.note: Nothing precedes the empty key.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__pos_append
idris.note: Appending a fact to working memory leaves every live fact's position: the assertion sequence only grows, [IRET.4.4].

idris.name: ldet_5_5__pos_inj
idris.note: Two live facts at one position are one fact.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__sorted_append
idris.note: A sorted terminal of live activations is sorted under working memory grown by a fact: no live key changes.

idris.name: Ldet_5_5__ordered_acts
idris.note: A TERMINAL IN AGENDA ORDER: sorted by the timetag under the working memory given, every activation of live facts.

idris.name: Ldet_5_5__ordered_net
idris.note: Every terminal of the network in agenda order.

idris.name: Ldet_5_9__ordered
idris.note: THE ORDERED VIEW: the view, and every terminal in agenda order under the engine's working memory.

idris.name: iret_19_1__insert_ordered
idris.note: INSERTING A FRESH FACT keeps the order: the survivors' keys are unchanged under the grown working memory, and the new matches take their places.

idris.name: iret_6_4__dispatch_assert_ordered
idris.note: ALPHA DISPATCH ON ASSERT keeps the order over any distinct list of alphas to visit.

idris.name: iret_6_4__dispatch_assert_ordered_step
idris.note: ONE ALPHA VISITED ON ASSERT, admitting the fact, keeps the order: every chain is right-activated from a memory grown by a live fact new to it.

idris.name: iret_7_7__right_activate_ordered
idris.note: RIGHT-ACTIVATION KEEPS THE ORDER: the matches the fact completes are live and new to the terminal and take their timetags' places; the survivors keep theirs; what a NOT node newly blocks ends.

idris.name: iret_7_7__wave_ordered
idris.note: LEFT-ACTIVATION KEEPS THE ORDER: the arrivals, live and new to the terminal, activate at their timetags' places.

idris.name: iret_7_8__unwave_ordered
idris.note: LEFT-RETRACTION KEEPS THE ORDER: the activations that end leave a sublist.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__canonical
idris.note: THE CANONICAL ORDER of a set of matches: each at its key's place, from nothing. A function of the matches and of working memory alone -- what a from-scratch build produces.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__lmem_live
idris.note: A token of a left memory showing a live front is live.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__view_live_acts
idris.note: Under the view every activation is live: its match is in the recompute, which is built from memories that show working memory.

idris.name: ldet_5_9__order_after_history
idris.note: THE ORDER THEOREM, closed at the top: after any history from a loaded network -- every input pumped, in order -- every terminal's activations are, in order, the canonical order over working memory of the chain's recompute.

idris.name: ldet_5_9__ordered_recompute
idris.note: UNDER THE ORDERED VIEW every terminal is, in order, the canonical order over working memory of its chain's recompute: the agenda order is a function of the activation set and of working memory, never of how the set was reached. Batched equals incremental in order, and a released match fires where it first completed.

idris.name: ltac_5_4__same_tick_timed
idris.note: Two activations of one rule completing together, ordered by their facts' assertion positions: the earlier-minted timer first. Executed.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__first_pending_no
idris.note: A head that is not pending is skipped: the first pending token is one position later.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__first_pending_yes
idris.note: A pending head is the first pending token.

idris.name: Ldet_5_5__lex_sorted
idris.note: A tuple list in pattern order under a working memory: each tuple's key lexicographically before every later one's. FireLoop's enumeration order, facts outermost.

idris.name: Ldet_5_5__pos_sorted
idris.note: Facts in working-memory order: each at an earlier position than every later one -- the positions the key reads.

idris.name: Ldet_5_5__sorted_tuples
idris.note: A tuple list in agenda order under a working memory: each tuple's canonical key before every later one's. The clause's order stated on bare tuples, so that a FireLoop table and a network terminal compare as lists.

idris.name: iret_7_4__extend_lex_sorted
idris.note: Facts outermost: the blocks of a position-sorted fact list, each a sorted list of extensions, concatenate to a sorted list.

idris.name: iret_7_4__tuples_lex_sorted
idris.note: THE ENUMERATION IS LEXICOGRAPHIC: the tuples of the positive kinds, facts outermost in working-memory order, are sorted by their keys in pattern order.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__before_keys_lt
idris.note: A key completed earlier comes first.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__before_keys_same_latest
idris.note: Two keys completed at the same position compare by pattern order.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__filter_pos_sorted
idris.note: A sublist of a distinct working memory, taken by a test, sits at increasing positions: the facts of a kind, in order.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__latest_below
idris.note: A key whose positions all lie below a bound completed below it, or is empty.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__latest_bounded
idris.note: The latest of a key bounded above is bounded above.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__latest_of_bound
idris.note: A key holding a position no other exceeds completed at it.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__lex_cons_lt
idris.note: A key with the earlier first position comes first.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__lex_cons_same
idris.note: Keys with the same first position compare by their rests.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__lex_sorted_append
idris.note: Two lists in pattern order, every tuple of the first before every tuple of the second, append to one.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__lex_sorted_cons
idris.note: Prefixing every tuple of a sorted list with one fact keeps it sorted: the first positions agree and the rest decide.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__lex_sorted_filter
idris.note: A sublist of a list in pattern order, taken by a test, is in pattern order.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__lex_to_sorted
idris.note: ONE EVENT'S MATCHES, all completed at one position, are in the key's order when they are in pattern order: the latest positions tie, so the key falls through to the lexicographic comparison.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__lt_succ_not
idris.note: Below a successor is not above its predecessor: the strict order on positions.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__max_bounded
idris.note: The maximum with a bound the other does not exceed is the bound.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__pos_cons_neq
idris.note: A fact other than the head sits one position later than in the tail.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__pos_head
idris.note: The head of working memory is at position zero.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__pos_last
idris.note: The position of the fact appended is the length: the latest.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__pos_lt_length
idris.note: A live fact's position is below the length.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__pos_sorted_lift
idris.note: Positions read in a longer working memory: a list sorted under the tail, none of whose facts is the head, is sorted under the whole.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__sorted_tuples_append
idris.note: Two sorted lists, every tuple of the first before every tuple of the second, append to a sorted list.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__sorted_tuples_distinct
idris.note: A sorted tuple list is distinct: the order is irreflexive.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__sorted_tuples_filter
idris.note: A sublist of a sorted tuple list, taken by a test, is sorted.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__sorted_tuples_of_acts
idris.note: A sorted terminal's tuples are sorted: the activations' order is their matches'.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__sorted_tuples_transport
idris.note: The order is carried by any working memory that orders the tuples the same way.

idris.name: Iret_8_1__well
idris.note: A WELL-FORMED TABLE of Rete/FireLoop.idr: every token's facts live, and the tuples in the key's order.

idris.name: iret_8_1__new_latest
idris.note: A tuple holding the new fact, live in the grown memory, completed at the new fact's position: the last.

idris.name: iret_8_1__nil_before
idris.note: The nil match comes before every match of a fact.

idris.name: iret_8_1__old_before_new
idris.note: A match live in the old memory comes before a match the new fact completes: the timetag of the clause, read off positions.

idris.name: iret_8_1__prop_well_grow
idris.note: PROPAGATION AFTER A FACT ENTERS keeps the table well-formed: the kept tokens keep their order under the grown memory; the added tokens, all completed at the new fact's position, follow them in pattern order, which is the key's order among them.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__sorted_tuples_of_filter
idris.note: The tuples of a sublist of tokens, taken by a test, stay sorted.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__sorted_tuples_sub_one
idris.note: A sublist of a list of at most one tuple is sorted.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__insert_distinct
idris.note: Inserting an activation not already held keeps the list distinct.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__insert_elem_here
idris.note: The inserted activation is in the list.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__insert_elem_inv
idris.note: An activation of the list after an insert is the new one or an old one.

idris.name: ldet_5_5__insert_elem_old
idris.note: An old activation is in the list after an insert.
